links.note: Was 24067 Language policy. The 1956 Act in question is Sri Lanka's - Sinhala as the only official language, Buddhism protected by the state, Sinhalas favoured in government jobs. That is Power Sharing's majoritarian measures (24043 in chapter 23710). 24067 is India's three-language policy, a different country and a different arrangement; the two share only the word 'language'.
